title: io.loams.dev.usage.postgres.storage.v1
description: The `data` of a `io.loams.dev.usage.postgres.storage.v1` usage event: A Postgres branch's logical size, hourly (a gauge). Producer: pg-control storage round. Design §63 §6.3. Measured values are integers in the unit named; dimensions are strings. New optional fields may be added within v1.
